cards.label: Zepbound Savings Card (commercial insurance that covers Zepbound)

eligibility.notes: Cardholders must not be enrolled in Medicaid, Medicare (incl. Part D and Advantage), Medigap, DoD, VA, TRICARE/CHAMPUS or state drug assistance programs.

cards.source_note: 'pay as little as $25 for a 1-month, 2-month, or 3-month prescription fill of Zepbound single-dose pen'; 'maximum monthly savings of up to $100 per 1-month prescription'; annual maximum $1,300; 'Card expires and savings end on 12/31/2026'. LillyDirect also shows 'Insurance price: Pay as low as $25 per month' for KwikPen.

cards.label: Zepbound Savings Card (commercial insurance that does not cover Zepbound)

eligibility.notes: Maximum monthly savings are 'based on wholesale acquisition cost minus $499'.

cards.source_note: 'pay as low as $499 for your 1-month prescription fill of Zepbound single-dose pen' for commercially insured without coverage. A KwikPen variant ('as low as $299' at 2.5 mg, dose-specific caps) exists but its per-dose floors were not fully stated, so it is not modelled.

cards.label: Wegovy Savings Offer (commercial insurance)

eligibility.notes: 'Government beneficiaries excluded.' Novo Nordisk may modify or cancel the program at any time. Duration/expiry not stated on the page.

cards.source_note: 'Pay as little as $25, subject to a maximum savings of $100/month.'
